title: Grandfather Eusebio and family musicians
summary: Her father had no musical brothers; his father Eusebio played guitar for amusement; none of her brothers or sons play.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was gonna ask, before I forget it, uh, did any of your uncles, did your father have any brothers that played?
No. He was the only one.
The only one. And did his father play any instrument, do you know?
No. Uh, yes, I think he did. He played the guitar. But I think more so for himself. Just, uh, you know, to amuse himself. He didn't go out and make a living at it like my father did.
Do you remember? That's your grandfather. Do you remember him? Oh, yes. Do you remember? What was his first name?
That's a usual name for me.
I have a brother named Eusebio. He's named after him. Uh-huh. And I have two brothers and three sons and none of them play music. Oh. None of them.
